description: List the codes Grants.gov search filters accept, with labels and live opportunity counts: agencies (top level, or one agency's sub-agencies via parent_code, or matched by name via name_contains), applicant eligibility types, funding categories, funding instruments, statuses, sort options, and keyword syntax. Use the codes as grantsgov_search_opportunities inputs.

name_contains.description: Keep only entries whose label or code contains every word given, ignoring case, accents, and punctuation (e.g. "national science", "nih"). For agencies this searches every code, top-level and sub-agency. Works with every topic. A value with no letters or digits matches nothing.

parent_code.description: Agencies only: list every code under this agency at any depth (e.g. HHS, DOD-DARPA). Case-insensitive. Omit for the top-level list.

topic.description: Which list to return: agencies (agency codes), eligibilities (two-digit applicant-type codes), funding_categories, funding_instruments, statuses, sort_options, or keyword_syntax.

name: grantsgov_list_reference

code.description: Value to pass to the matching grantsgov_search_opportunities input (agencies, eligibilities, funding_categories, funding_instruments, statuses, or sort); for keyword_syntax, the form to write inside keyword.

description.description: Usage notes for statuses, sort_options, and keyword_syntax entries.

has_children.description: agencies only: true when the code has sub-agencies (searching it includes them).

open_count.description: Forecasted + posted opportunities with this code. For an agency, the count a grantsgov_search_opportunities agencies filter on this code returns: the code and every sub-agency under it.

parent_code.description: agencies only: the parent agency code.

total_count.description: Opportunities with this code across all statuses, counted the same way as open_count.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_parent_code`: parent_code is not a known agency code. `filter_not_applicable`: parent_code given with a topic other than agencies. `upstream_unavailable`: The snapshot fetch failed after retries and no cached snapshot exists. `rate_limited`: The snapshot fetch got HTTP 429 (rate limited) through every retry, and no cached snapshot exists. `upstream_route_unavailable`: The snapshot fetch got HTTP 403 Missing Authentication Token (the search route no longer exists at the gateway), and no cached snapshot exists. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when name_contains matched nothing, or when parent_code has no sub-agencies.

snapshot_date.description: When the live vocabulary was fetched (ISO timestamp); absent for fully static topics.

title: List Grants.gov Reference Codes
